package.name: Pokédex Scanner
package.description: Scans Pokémon on first encounter, renders a Pokédex entry card in the chat, and tracks the trainer's active harem, pregnancies, and recent encounters. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode. Once active, configure it in its standalone Pokédex Scanner section.
